tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear Blue Sapphire gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Blue Sapphire Gemstone is a member of the Corundum mineral family and is extremely resilient. High quality Blue Sapphire gemstones have a unique velvety texture and a deep blue hue. The highest-quality blue sapphires come from Ceylon (Sri Lanka), Burma, Kashmir (India), and Madagascar. Due to the Blue Sapphire's association with Shani Graha and its mystic properties, it has been associated with royalty since ancient times.

Blue Sapphire balances the wearer's Ajna Chakra (3rd Eye Chakra) and protects the pituitary gland. The Ajna Chakra is related to intuition, foresight, inspiration, and imagination. Thus, it helps the wearer, being more charismatic, intuitive, and intelligent in all the spheres of life. This stunning blue gemstone leads to peace of mind through acceptance and good judgment. It brings order, structure, and discipline to one’s life.

The wearer of Blue Sapphire gemstone becomes a master of his life and destiny and manifests wealth, career success, harmonious relationships, respect, name, fame & power. It is also regarded as one of the most powerful gems due to the quickness with which it produces results and effects compared to the other Navratnas (9 Planetary Gemstones). It gives relief in sinus, headaches, vision problems and problems related to nightmares. Additionally, it alleviates a wide range of neurological disorders.

Royal Blue Sapphire is the world’s most famous engagement ring worn by kings, queens, and other royalty and historical figures due to its association with good fortune. While Kate Middleton's is currently the most renowned royal blue sapphire engagement ring, it is by no means the only example in history. Napoleon proposed to his prospective wife Josephine in 1795 with a unique blue sapphire and diamond "You and Me" ring. Despite the fact that blue sapphire engagement rings have increased in popularity over the past decade, this gemstone has been a favorite of royalty and notable figures for centuries.

According to many religions, the sapphire's intense blue color represents Heaven. The jewel is ingrained in worldwide religious history and folklore. In ancient and medieval times, blue sapphires represented the pinnacle of celestial faith and a sense of hope. They were also considered to provide protection, spiritual insight, and fortunate fate.

In modern times, it is believed that these striking blue stones liberate their wearers from any type of spiritual confusion, mental tension, melancholy, and undesirable thoughts. They symbolize the restoration of balance within the body, assisting to align the spiritual, mental, and physical dimensions and bringing about mental clarity and tranquility.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although a blue sapphire gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that a consultation with an expert trained in RRCT (Rudraksha Ratna Chakra Therapy) is sought. In Chakra science, it balances the Ajna or the Third Eye Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for good decision making power and intuitive foresight. One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone.

 

If the planet Saturn holds a weak position in your birth chart, you should wear a blue sapphire gemstone. Blue sapphire helps you enhance your status in life.  Individuals undergoing Sade Sati or Dasha or Shani Dev are recommended to wear the blue sapphire gemstone. It is also recommended for stock market traders, investment bankers, risk analysts, strategists, administrators, astrologers, psychics, forecasters, and consultants.

 

Many people are scared to wear Blue Sapphires as it rules planet Saturn who is one of the most feared celestial beings in astrology. Individuals need to understand that planets are not your friends or enemies but they are your guides or teachers and their approach and teaching methodology is different, some are strict, and others are more merciful or benevolent. Saturn is like a strict school teacher who wishes to evolve you by making you learn lessons the hard way. Saturn brings order, structure, discipline, and hard work into our lives for the attainment of meaningful purposes; thus, we should embrace Saturn, as wearing blue sapphire not only mitigates the negative effects of a poorly placed natal Saturn, but also aligns its energy with our highest goals when worn as per RRCT.

 

Blue sapphire bestows name, fame, fortune, and wealth upon the wearer. The wearer can anticipate achieving a prominent position in society. Therefore is strongly suggested for politicians and anyone else in the public spotlight. The blue sapphire gemstone has a direct effect on wealth and can cause an increase in finances. It bolsters the wearer's income with multiple sources of revenue. As a result, blue sapphire can be relied upon for achieving home and business financial stability.

Wearing blue sapphire gemstone can greatly benefit surgeons, astrologers, researchers, doctors, scientists, writers, and engineers. Neelam assists them in refining their skills and knowledge so that they can tackle difficult challenges with ease. Similarly, because blue sapphire opens the Third Eye chakra, it is an ideal gemstone for those who want to excel in the arts and sciences, architecture, literature, journalism, and many other professions that require sharp intuition, innovative creativity and imagination.

On a spiritual level, blue sapphire also provides immense benefits. Neelam gemstone improves meditation, helps in introspection, self-inquiry and self-realization. The pure blue radiance of Neelam conveys a restorative vibration that is beneficial to the mind, allowing order and clarity when there is confusion and focusing any dispersed or unfocused thoughts. It imparts mental resilience and enables us to see past illusions in order to unveil concealed truths.

 

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Blue Sapphire gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Blue Sapphire gemstones.

Blue Sapphire Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Ceylon (Sri Lanka) is the source of the finest blue sapphires available at reasonable prices. The mines have not produced premium Kashmir sapphires for many years, so they are rarely available at affordable prices.

 

Observe their Color:

The best quality Blue Sapphire gemstones are rich blue in color and unique velvety texture. Less intense or deeper blue sapphires are less expensive per carat than pale, gray, and sky-blue sapphires. While the ideal color intensity is a matter of personal preference, you should always look for sweet, open tones. The gemstone should not be too dark or blackish in color.

 

Notice their Clarity:

Avoid moderate to severe color partitioning (transparency streaks with no color). Avoid purchasing very low-quality blue sapphire which are extremely milky and have black spots in them.

 

Examine their Inclusions:

Natural blue sapphires will have some inclusions & bubbles. The lesser the inclusions the higher will be the price of the gemstone. Make sure the inclusions are inside the gemstone, do not purchase blue sapphires with surface level cracks, chips, or any form of damage. To distinguish between inclusions and surface level cracks you can run your nails across the crack if your nails get stuck. That means the surface is damaged if not then it is an inclusion inside the gemstone which is natural.

Avoid purchasing glass like clear Blue Sapphires without certification from a trusted laboratory. It is recommended to purchase blue sapphires with less inclusion which are not visible to the naked eye. Avoid buying blue sapphires which are cloudy and milky and have many black spots/impurities inside them.

 

See their Shape:

To maximize their carat weight, sapphires are faceted. Ovals and cushions tend to maximize weight and, consequently, value. Rounds are more expensive because valuable material must be removed from the corners to create them. Emerald and radiant cuts are less frequent in blue sapphires, but they can occasionally be found at reasonable prices. The shape is a personal preference one can choose any shape however should ensure that the sapphire is unheated, untreated and certified from a reputable source.

 

Check the Carats:

For Blue Sapphire of gem quality, the raw Blue Sapphire is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Blue Sapphire weighing between 1 and 5 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Blue Sapphire is sold by weight, Blue Sapphire prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Blue Sapphire has, the higher its price.

 

Avoid Heated & Treated Blue Sapphire

Due to treatments the Blue Sapphire stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Blue Sapphire do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

 

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Blue Sapphire gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Blue Sapphire are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

 

Why buy Blue Sapphire from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

 

Can I give my used Blue Sapphire gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

How to Energize & Recharge Blue Sapphire Gemstone?

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Blue Sapphire is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life.

 

How to know if Blue Sapphire is working?

You feel the ability to foresee future events and to sense different things from and beyond reality as you once knew and viewed it. Additionally, you observe more brilliant and vibrant hues, such as in flowers, leaves, and the sky, and you begin to see flashes of light all around you. Blue Sapphire is one of the most potent and fast-acting gemstones, so you should begin attracting good luck, better prospects, easier achievement of your goals, increases in sales and wealth, and a sudden rise in your personal and professional (business) profile. All these inner or outer signs indicate your Neelam is working.

 

How long do the effects of Blue Sapphire last?

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Blue Sapphire gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Blue Sapphire is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality blue sapphire is pure blue in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation and tone that is not too dark or light. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.  

Cut

Best quality blue sapphires have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation, and surface area. The optimal cuts for a blue sapphire are oval, round, and cushion. A round cut is considered to be one of the most classic shapes, and it maximizes the gem's brilliance. Cushion cut, also known as the 'pillow-cut,' has been beloved for generations due to its resemblance to a cushion.

Carat

Blue Sapphire of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Blue Sapphire are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Blue Sapphire rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Blue Sapphire typically contains some inclusions. These inclusions are natural and can be in the form of bubbles, cracks or fissures, or black spots. However, if the stones are naturally unheated and untreated they bestow their benefits. It is recommended to wear stones with lesser inclusions and the highest clarity.

The fewer the inclusions, the brighter and clearer the blue sapphire. Inclusions in premium quality blue sapphire are almost invisible to the naked eye, whereas inclusions in economy grade stones are more visible. Therefore, the wearer has the option of wearing 1-4 carats in Premium Grade stones or more than 4 carats in Economy Grade stones.

Dealers deal in Blue Sapphire stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Blue Sapphire gemstone Price

The price of Blue Sapphire can range from INR 12000/carat to INR 130,000/carat.

Blue sapphire price depends upon various factors such as quality (4Cs), origin and treatment among others. Depending upon the color, clarity and cut, blue sapphires can be categorized as economy and premium grade stones.

Please note that we at Rudra Centre deal only in 100% natural untreated and unheated premium quality certified blue sapphires sourced responsibly from all over the world.      

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Blue Sapphire has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Blue Sapphire stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Blue Sapphire gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 45,000 to INR 8,22,150 (USD 562 to USD 10.276).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Blue Sapphire?

The best way to check the authenticity of Blue Sapphire is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Blue Sapphires are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Blue Sapphire carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Blue Sapphire is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Blue Sapphires have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Neelams, but if you find flaws, then your Blue Sapphire is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Blue Sapphires are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Neelams. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Blue Sapphire, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Blue Sapphire from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Blue Sapphire. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Neelam. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural blue color of the gem.

Blue Sapphire Cleaning & Maintenance

Blue Sapphires must be cleaned frequently to preserve their vibrant sparkle.

First you need to polish it using a soft, dry jewelry polishing cloth. Before using soap and water, polishing the gemstones will remove some of the less tenacious stains and tarnishes, making the entire cleaning process more effective and efficient.

Soak the Blue Sapphire for several minutes in lukewarm, soapy water. After soaking, remove stubborn smudges and dirt with a soft-bristled toothbrush or a soft-bristled cloth. Avoid scratching its surface while washing it and then you may rinse it in a natural source of water or hold it under cold, running water from any natural faucet.

Add a pinch of Himalayan or sea salt to the cleansing process to assist the Blue Sapphire in releasing any negative energy it may have absorbed from prolonged use or when worn for the first time.

For optimal energization, you may allow it to dry in early sunlight or full moonlight so that light can pass through it.
